groups.meta: unlocks Empyrean, the Plexus and Tenno Lab research

disclosures.title: dojo prerequisites
disclosures.body: A brand-new solo clan needs Clan Hall, a connector, a Reactor and the Oracle standing before the Tenno Lab research console exists at all; budget that dojo build separately from the Itzal research itself.

groups.activity: research Itzal, then Harness, Systems and Wings
groups.meta: Ghost tier shown; scale x3/x10/x30/x100 for Shadow/Storm/Mountain/Moon

rows.label: Itzal
rows.note: 3,000 clan affinity, 10,000 cr, 1 Fieldron, 1 Mutagen Mass, 1 Detonite Injector, 2 Tellurium, 72h

rows.label: Harness
rows.note: 1,500 affinity, 4,000 cr, 1 Detonite Injector, 250 Oxium, 5,500 Ferrite, 1 Tellurium, 36h

rows.label: Systems
rows.note: 1,500 affinity, 5,500 cr, 1 Mutagen Mass, 3,750 Oxium, 72,500 Salvage, 1 Tellurium, 36h

rows.label: Wings
rows.note: 1,500 affinity, 4,500 cr, 1 Fieldron, 3,750 Oxium, 6,400 Ferrite, 1 Tellurium, 36h

conditions: Harness, Systems and Wings all list Itzal as a prerequisite, so the first 72h cannot be parallelized; research is never rushable with platinum.
Clan research blueprints are untradeable; the only shortcut is 325 plat for the finished Archwing in the Market.
bonuses: Joining a clan that has already finished this research skips straight to buying the four blueprints for 15,000 cr each.

disclosures.title: join, don't research
disclosures.body: Every large clan already has Itzal researched, so the near-unanimous advice is to join one instead of paying Moon or Mountain tier costs yourself. Buy all four blueprints before leaving a clan; lab console access dies with membership.

conditions: Submersible missions count as Archwing missions, the only reason Grineer there drop Tellurium at all.
Heat and Corrosive kills disintegrate corpses and block Desecrate; mod Heat off before running Nekros.
bonuses: Corpus Railjack Survival (e.g. Luckless Expanse, Veil Proxima) drowns you in Tellurium as a side effect of Intrinsics or Bile farming.

rows.label: Oxium
rows.alt: Cetus/Fortuna Lvl 10-30 bounties, 200 at 25% on stage 1

conditions: Only Oxium Ospreys drop it, and only if you land the kill; they won't self-destruct at full shield/low health, so Toxin damage (bypasses shields) is the reliable trigger.
